source: Kaggle Walmart Recruiting II: Sales in Stormy Weather

provenance.date_policy: Original dates retained. Any application date shift is a labelled scenario, not current observed sales.
provenance.location_policy: No store or station coordinates are supplied. A scenario city is not an identified Walmart store location.
provenance.sales_policy: 112 consecutive observed days for each of ten registered products; no imputation or synthetic sales.
provenance.weather_policy: Original daily values and M/T markers. Training defaults/causal fill apply at inference; these are observations, not issued forecasts.
